```{r}
library(haven)
library(lavaan)

d <- read_sav("ECLSK2011_K5PUF.sav",
              col_select = c(S2_ID, W1C0, X2PLTOT, X12LANGST, P1PRMLNG, P2PRIMLN, X_RACETH_R,
                             X2PUBPRI, X4PUBPRI, X7PUBPRI, X9PUBPRI,
                             X2RSCALK5, X4RSCALK5, X7RSCALK5, X9RSCALK5))
d <- as.data.frame(zap_labels(d))

recode <- c("X2PLTOT", "X2RSCALK5", "X4RSCALK5", "X7RSCALK5", "X9RSCALK5")
d[recode] <- lapply(d[recode], function(x) ifelse(x %in% c(-9, -8, -7, -1), NA, x))

d <- d[rowSums(!is.na(d[c("X2RSCALK5", "X4RSCALK5", "X7RSCALK5", "X9RSCALK5")])) > 0, ]
d <- d[!(d$X2PLTOT %in% 0:15), ]
d <- d[!(d$X2PUBPRI %in% 2 | d$X4PUBPRI %in% 2 | d$X7PUBPRI %in% 2 | d$X9PUBPRI %in% 2), ]

d$group <- ifelse(d$X12LANGST == 2, 1,
             ifelse(d$P1PRMLNG == 2 | d$P2PRIMLN == 2, 2,
               ifelse(d$X12LANGST != 2 & d$X_RACETH_R == 5, 3, 0)))
d <- d[d$group %in% 1:3, ]
d$group <- factor(d$group, 1:3, c("English", "Spanish", "Asian"))
table(d$group)

d <- d[d$W1C0 > 0, ]
nrow(d)
```

```{r}
model <- "
i =~ 1*X2RSCALK5 + 1*X4RSCALK5 + 1*X7RSCALK5 + 1*X9RSCALK5
s =~ 0*X2RSCALK5 + 1*X4RSCALK5 + 3*X7RSCALK5 + 5*X9RSCALK5
q =~ 0*X2RSCALK5 + 1*X4RSCALK5 + 9*X7RSCALK5 + 25*X9RSCALK5
X2RSCALK5 ~~ 0*X2RSCALK5
X9RSCALK5 ~~ 0*X9RSCALK5
"

fit <- function(extra = "") {
  growth(paste(model, extra), data = d, group = "group", group.label = levels(d$group),
         estimator = "MLR", missing = "ml", sampling.weights = "W1C0", cluster = "S2_ID")
}

base <- fit()
eng_asi_i <- fit("i ~ c(a, b, a)*1")
spa_asi_i <- fit("i ~ c(b, a, a)*1")
eng_spa_i <- fit("i ~ c(a, a, b)*1")
spa_asi_s <- fit("s ~ c(b, a, a)*1")
```

```{r}
est <- parameterEstimates(base)
est <- est[est$op == "~1" & est$lhs %in% c("i", "s", "q"), c("group", "lhs", "est", "se")]

data.frame(
  group = c("English", "Spanish", "Asian"),
  i = est$est[est$lhs == "i"],
  s = est$est[est$lhs == "s"],
  q = est$est[est$lhs == "q"]
)
```

```{r}
test <- function(m) lavTestLRT(base, m, method = "satorra.bentler.2001")[2, "Pr(>Chisq)"]

data.frame(
  comparison = c("intercept English = Asian", "intercept Spanish = Asian",
                 "intercept English = Spanish", "slope Spanish = Asian"),
  p = c(test(eng_asi_i), test(spa_asi_i), test(eng_spa_i), test(spa_asi_s))
)
```
